def _validate_release(model, totals):
    require(keys(model, RELEASE_FIELDS))
    require(identifier(model['id']))
    require(integer(model['classes'], 1, 16))
    require(integer(model['width'], 2, 16))
    require(fraction(model['eps']) and fraction(model['ratio']))
    require(model['ratio'][0] <= model['ratio'][1])
    require(fraction(model['threshold']))
    require(type(model['mode']) is str and model['mode'] in ('range', 'exact'))
    require(integer(model['packet_limit'], model['width'], 200000))
    require(integer(model['idle_us'], 0, 10 ** 12))
    for group in ('discovery', 'train', 'validation'):
        rows = model[group]
        require(type(rows) is list)
        totals[group] += len(rows)
        labels = set()
        for row in rows:
            discovery = group == 'discovery'
            require(keys(row, 'class values activation' if discovery else 'class values'))
            require(integer(row['class'], 0, model['classes'] - 1))
            labels.add(row['class'])
            totals['values'] += _check_values(row['values'], 2 if discovery else 0)
            if discovery:
                activation = row['activation']
                require(type(activation) is list and len(activation) == len(row['values']))
                for score in activation:
                    require(integer(score, 0, 1000000))
        if group != 'discovery':
            require(labels == set(range(model['classes'])))
    return model['id']
